item.title: Brandi Carlile Postpones U.K. and European Tour Citing ‘Personal Circumstances’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Trending on Billboard. I'm your host, and today we have some updates on Brandi Carlile's tour. Brandi has just announced that she's postponing the UK and European leg of her tour due to personal circumstances.
[Short music transition]
Host: The tour was originally set to kick off in October, but it's now been pushed to March 2027. Unfortunately, her Lisbon show has been canceled outright, but two new dates have been added in Wolverhampton, England, and Copenhagen. If you're a ticketholder for the Lisbon show, don't worry – you'll be getting a full refund. And if you're affected by the venue changes in England, you'll also get a refund, plus priority access to the new dates.
[Short music transition]
Host: It's worth noting that this postponement only affects the UK and European leg of the tour. The US leg is still on track to start next week in Maine, supporting her eighth studio album, Returning to Myself. Brandi has had an incredible run in recent years, with breakthrough albums like By the Way, I Forgive You and In These Silent Days earning her multiple Grammys and chart-topping spots.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard. We'll keep you updated on any more news from Brandi Carlile and other trending artists.
